description: Input template for selecting among externally generated MIMIC-IV CoDSA candidates
usage: Replace each probability path with a .npy file produced by a CoDSA implementation and its fitted classifier. Relative paths are resolved from this manifest's directory.
probability_format: One positive-class probability per validation or test row, with shape (n,), (n, 1), or (n, 2). For shape (n, 2), column 1 is used.
protocol: Each candidate encodes a CoDSA (r, alpha, m) tuple and classifier hyperparameters. Candidate and probability threshold are selected jointly by validation F1; test probabilities are final-only.
